item.title: Automate Your Lab - Part 7 - Central GPO Store
item.description: The central GPO store is a folder where you put in all your .admx and .adml files which then get replicated to all other domain controllers. It’s an optional part when setting up your lab. But I like the idea of centralization and storing files only one time, that’s why I added it to my automation.
